title: Guided Version Pinning & Profile Publish UX for Model Onboarding
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Design and implement a guided console experience for onboarding new model versions that helps users select and pin a model version and publish a corresponding performance profile. The flow should reduce cognitive load for engineers and platform owners by surfacing contextual defaults, automatic regressions checks, and a lightweight compare view for performance snapshots before publishing. This ticket covers the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout gating for the console UX.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open a contextual 'Choose Version' panel from the model detail page that lists available model versions, display names, and a brief runtime cost/latency estimate for the current customer tier.
A 'Pin to Route' action is available that guides the user through selecting environment (dev/stage/prod), rollback window, and optional canary percentage.

Before completing pinning, the console displays an inline performance profile inspector showing the latest computed profile snapshot and a side-by-side comparison with the currently pinned version (latency P50/P95, token cost, common prompt regressions).

Publishing a performance profile requires passing preflight checks: eval pass-rate >= threshold, no high-severity regressions, and successful automated smoke tests. Failure surfaces actionable remediation steps.
Telemetry: pin events, publish events, canary rollout steps, and preflight failures are emitted to analytics and shown in the route's history timeline.
RBAC: only users with 'model-release' permission can publish profiles or pin to prod. Console UI hides or disables controls otherwise and links to documentation on how to request access.
tasks: Write PRD with flow diagrams and state table (link to confluence).
Design mocks for modal, compare view, and preflight error states.
Implement API endpoints for fetching profile snapshots and running preflight checks (ENG).
Console front-end: version chooser panel, pin dialog, publish profile button, and history entries.
Integrate telemetry and audit events into Console and Route timeline.
End-to-end QA: canary rollout simulation and manual QA runbook.
Documentation: user guide and changelog blurb for console-2025.03 release.
notes: Design trade-off: avoid overloading the panel with raw metrics. Show top-line metrics and a 'drill into full profile' link to the perf dashboard.
We should prefer automated defaults: suggest current stable pinned version as baseline, pre-select dev environment for first-time pins, and set canary to 10% by default for prod pins.
Perf profile snapshots are generated by the onboarding pipeline (ENG-2799). If a snapshot is older than 72 hours show a warning and a 'recompute now' action.
Security: publishing writes an audit entry and requires 'model-release' permission. This is enforced server-side and the console will show a linked approval request flow for blocked users.
Consider adding an 'undo pin' quick action for 5 minutes post-publish (soft rollback) as a follow-up.
